answer: Make the shared vault open only after verified work: an identity earns entry by completing attested tasks, so each new account must pay in real output before it can claim rewards. Picture a terrace, not a flat field — newcomers start low with small capped jobs and rise only as their record grows. A gale of fresh accounts then meets a wall of time and proof, and running many identities costs genuine work per identity instead of a free copy-paste.
